newsitem.title: GUYANA: Guyanese police search for cut-and-run gang.
newsitem.headline: Guyanese police search for cut-and-run gang.

text.p: Guyanese police are looking for thieves who chopped down two houses built on wooden stilts to steal their contents.
The three robbers made off with cash and jewelry worth 285 from one house but were unable to enter the other, even after felling it with machetes, the police said on Thursday.
The thefts took place recently in a village 50 miles (80 km) east of Georgetown, the capital, they added. Houses in Guyana are traditionally built on stilts to combat pests and floods.
